verdict: Solid 28-day return, but the last 7 days show real pressure on efficiency.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you drove $8,157.69 in revenue on $1,488.56 in Meta ad spend, a 5.48 return on ad spend (ROAS), with 44 purchases recorded. Purchases were up 28.57% versus the prior 7-day window, which is a genuine bright spot — however, ROAS fell 34.01% in that same recent 7 days despite spend holding nearly flat, and the last three days of the period recorded no revenue against $186.45 in spend, confirming this is a real efficiency shift worth watching, not a reporting glitch. Separately, purchase event tracking on-site is firing inconsistently, which means the ROAS figure above likely under-reports true performance — that tracking fix is in motion now. Google Business Profile engagement also dropped sharply this past week and is being investigated; several planned deliverables are also being brought current to keep the broader launch timeline on track.

watch_item.issue: ROAS dropped 34.01% over the last 7 days, with the final three days showing zero attributed revenue — a confirmed efficiency reversal, not noise.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative and campaign performance are being reviewed this week to identify and address the cost-versus-revenue gap before it carries into the next period.
